notes.subject: נפרד
notes.rationale: Famous crux: 'he who separates himself' (KJV/ASV) vs repointed נִבְרָד 'the one at ease/isolated' — object or subject of the seeking.

notes.subject: לתאוה
notes.rationale: Whose desire? 'his own desire' vs 'a desire' that drives him; also some read לְתֹאֵבָה 'according to his appetite'.

notes.subject: יתגלע
notes.rationale: Rare verb, literally 'to show the bare forehead' — obstinate, defiant exposition; rendered 'stronghed agensem'.

translation: Long wanpela laik, man i go ausait long ol man i painim; em i stronghed agensem olgeta gutpela save.

tokens.gloss: man i go ausait long ol man
gutpela save i stap long olgeta samting
